DM-only entry

Every sale starts by hand

“DM me align” means each lead is a private conversation that you or a setter has to qualify one by one. It works, but it only grows as fast as the inbox can be answered.

Not ready yet

Nothing for the curious

A follower who loves your mindset content but isn’t ready for 1:1 has nothing to say yes to. They keep watching for free, and you never find out who they are.

Reach

Reels reach a fraction of 133k

Your last 7 reels drew 2.1k to 6.3k views each, under 5% of your followers. Without ads, that is the ceiling on who sees the offer each week.

The high achievers who’d be perfect for your 1:1 are already following you. There’s no room yet where they can see your work up close and raise their hand.
